_comment: Manage your shop here. Set your WhatsApp number and shop-wide prices once, then add/remove posters. Each poster: title, category, img, alt, and a short unique desc (good for SEO). Run 'npm run build' to publish.

posters.title: Pillars of Creation
posters.alt: Pillars of Creation nebula metal print
posters.desc: The Hubble classic, printed on metal so the nebula's gas and dust glow with real depth. A statement space poster for a living room or studio wall.

posters.title: Carina Nebula
posters.alt: Carina Nebula JWST metal print
posters.desc: James Webb's view of the Carina Nebula on aluminium — the metal base makes the infrared colours luminous. A bold, modern astronomy print.

posters.title: Andromeda
posters.alt: Andromeda Galaxy metal print
posters.desc: Our nearest spiral galaxy, printed edge to edge on metal. Deep blacks and bright star fields that paper simply can't hold.

posters.title: Milky Way Nights
posters.alt: Milky Way night sky metal print
posters.desc: The Milky Way arching over a dark sky, printed on metal for a glossy, backlit feel. Calm, cinematic wall art for a bedroom.

posters.title: Dubai Marina, Night
posters.alt: Dubai Marina skyline at night metal print
posters.desc: Dubai Marina lit up after dark, printed on metal so the city lights really shine. A local favourite for homes and offices in the UAE.

posters.title: Dubai Marina, Day
posters.alt: Dubai Marina skyline daytime metal print
posters.desc: The Dubai Marina skyline by day on a crisp metal panel. Clean lines and blue sky — a bright, modern piece for any UAE wall.

posters.title: Desert Gold
posters.alt: Dubai desert sunset metal print
posters.desc: Golden dunes at sunset in the Dubai desert, printed on metal for warm, glowing tones. A calm, local landscape poster.

posters.title: Mountain Mirror
posters.alt: Mountain lake reflection metal print
posters.desc: A still alpine lake mirroring the peaks, printed on metal for extra clarity and shine. A fresh, peaceful nature print.

posters.title: Island Escape
posters.alt: Tropical island beach metal print
posters.desc: Turquoise water and a lone tree on a tropical beach, printed on metal so the colours pop. Holiday calm for your wall.

posters.title: Cherry Blossoms
posters.alt: Cherry blossom metal print
posters.desc: Cherry trees in full bloom over quiet railway tracks, printed on metal for soft pinks with a glossy finish. A gentle, seasonal favourite.

posters.title: Lions of Mara
posters.alt: Lion family portrait metal print
posters.desc: A lion family in the Masai Mara, printed on metal for rich, warm detail. A striking wildlife poster for a bold room.

posters.title: Classic Lambo
posters.alt: Classic Lamborghini metal print
posters.desc: A classic Lamborghini in showroom detail, printed on metal for a sharp, glossy finish. A must-have for a car lover's garage or office.

posters.title: 911 Turbo S
posters.alt: 911 Turbo S — metal poster printed in Dubai
posters.desc: The shape almost everyone can name from its silhouette alone. Metal suits it: the panel holds the reflections along the flanks the way the car's own paint does, without a sheet of glass bouncing the room back at you.

posters.title: Ancient Castle
posters.alt: Ancient Castle — metal poster printed in Dubai
posters.desc: Stonework, mist and a lot of texture in the mid-tones. The kind of illustration that rewards a larger size — 70×100 cm or up.

posters.title: Ancient Warrior
posters.alt: Ancient Warrior — metal poster printed in Dubai
posters.desc: Armour is metal, so printing it into metal is not just a pun — the panel's own sheen does some of the work the illustrator would otherwise have to fake.

posters.title: Bald Eagle
posters.alt: Bald Eagle — metal poster printed in Dubai
posters.desc: The white head against dark plumage is a brutal contrast step. Metal takes it without blowing out the highlights or blocking up the shadows.

posters.title: Bugatti Chiron
posters.alt: Bugatti Chiron — metal poster printed in Dubai
posters.desc: A hypercar built around one number, printed on a surface that keeps its gloss for decades. Deep blacks and hard highlights are exactly what dye-sublimation does better than paper.

posters.title: Dubai Skyline, Dusk
posters.alt: Dubai Skyline, Dusk — metal poster printed in Dubai
posters.desc: The same city an hour later, when the sky still has colour in it. A softer, warmer piece for a bedroom or a hallway.

posters.title: Dubai Skyline
posters.alt: Dubai Skyline — metal poster printed in Dubai
posters.desc: The view people move here for. City lights on a dark panel glow rather than sit flat, and there is no glass to mirror your own ceiling back over them.

posters.title: Ducati Panigale V4
posters.alt: Ducati Panigale V4 — metal poster printed in Dubai
posters.desc: Bare mechanical detail — trellis, exhaust, brake discs. Continuous tone with no paper grain means the small parts stay legible even at 30×40 cm.

posters.title: F-22 Raptor
posters.alt: F-22 Raptor — metal poster printed in Dubai
posters.desc: Faceted, matte and deliberately hard to see — the opposite of a supercar, and a good test of a print's shadow detail. Metal holds the dark greys apart instead of crushing them into one tone.

posters.title: Ferrari SF90 Spider
posters.alt: Ferrari SF90 Spider — metal poster printed in Dubai
posters.desc: Ferrari red is a hard colour to print — most papers dull it. Fused into the panel coating it stays saturated, and it will not shift towards orange in a sunlit room.

posters.title: Japanese Samurai
posters.alt: Japanese Samurai — metal poster printed in Dubai
posters.desc: Lacquered plate, silk cord and a limited palette. Flat areas of strong colour hold perfectly even, with no banding across the larger sizes.

posters.title: Lamborghini Revuelto
posters.alt: Lamborghini Revuelto — metal poster printed in Dubai
posters.desc: All creases and angles, which is the sort of subject that suffers on canvas — the weave softens every edge. On metal the linework stays sharp at any size.

posters.title: Majestic Wolf
posters.alt: Majestic Wolf — metal poster printed in Dubai
posters.desc: Grey on grey, which sounds simple and is not. The panel keeps the coat separated from the background instead of letting both settle into the same tone.

posters.title: Manhattan Skyline
posters.alt: Manhattan Skyline — metal poster printed in Dubai
posters.desc: Dense, vertical, and full of small bright windows — thousands of tiny highlights that need a surface which will not bleed them together.

posters.title: Futuristic Spaceship
posters.alt: Futuristic Spaceship — metal poster printed in Dubai
posters.desc: Hard-surface illustration with lit panel lines against deep space. Nothing here is photographic, which means the linework has to stay crisp — it does.

posters.title: McLaren P1
posters.alt: McLaren P1 — metal poster printed in Dubai
posters.desc: A shape designed entirely by airflow. The panel's gloss follows the curve of the bodywork, so the print reads as an object rather than as a picture of one.

posters.title: Mount Fuji
posters.alt: Mount Fuji — metal poster printed in Dubai
posters.desc: A snow line against clear sky is where paper prints usually fail — the white flattens. Infused into metal, the snow keeps its gradient and the sky keeps its depth.

posters.title: Northern Lights
posters.alt: Northern Lights — metal poster printed in Dubai
posters.desc: Aurora green over a dark sky is exactly the case metal was made for: luminous colour on near-black, with nothing on the surface to scatter it.

posters.title: Norwegian Fjords
posters.alt: Norwegian Fjords — metal poster printed in Dubai
posters.desc: Cold water, dark rock, and a lot of empty air. Metal handles the deep tones without going muddy, which is what makes the scale read.

posters.title: Anime Ninja
posters.alt: Anime Ninja — metal poster printed in Dubai
posters.desc: Hard cel edges and flat colour fills — the exact case where paper grain is most visible and most annoying. There is none here.

posters.title: Powerful Lion
posters.alt: Powerful Lion — metal poster printed in Dubai
posters.desc: Fur is fine detail across the whole frame — the first thing a canvas weave destroys. On a smooth panel every strand stays where the photographer put it.

posters.title: Rolls-Royce Spectre
posters.alt: Rolls-Royce Spectre — metal poster printed in Dubai
posters.desc: Restraint at scale. Large flat areas of colour show every flaw in a cheap print; on a dye-infused panel they stay perfectly even edge to edge.

posters.title: Snow-Covered Alps
posters.alt: Snow-Covered Alps — metal poster printed in Dubai
posters.desc: High contrast and very little colour, so the print lives or dies on tonal separation. Dye-sublimation keeps the shadowed snow distinct from the lit snow.

posters.title: Tokyo Street
posters.alt: Tokyo Street — metal poster printed in Dubai
posters.desc: Neon, wet asphalt and reflected signage. Saturated colour on near-black is the single best argument for printing on metal instead of paper.

posters.title: UH-60 Black Hawk
posters.alt: UH-60 Black Hawk — metal poster printed in Dubai
posters.desc: Utilitarian, purposeful, instantly recognisable to anyone who has been near one. Waterproof and knock-resistant, so a hangar or workshop wall is fair game.

posters.title: Black Dragon
posters.alt: Black Dragon — metal poster printed in Dubai
posters.desc: Almost entirely dark, which is the hardest thing to print well. On paper it turns to sludge; infused into the panel the scales and shadow stay separate.

posters.title: Kawasaki H2
posters.alt: Kawasaki H2 — metal poster printed in Dubai
posters.desc: Supercharged, and finished in a paint that behaves like a mirror. Printing it on metal is close to printing the material onto itself.

posters.title: Open Ocean
posters.alt: Open Ocean — metal poster printed in Dubai
posters.desc: Blue on blue, which needs a wide tonal range to avoid looking like a flat swatch. Also the obvious choice for a bathroom — it is waterproof.

posters.title: Private Jet
posters.alt: Private Jet — metal poster printed in Dubai
posters.desc: Polished aluminium against sky. The panel is the same material as the aircraft skin, which is a quiet joke worth making on an office wall.

posters.title: Sailing Yacht
posters.alt: Sailing Yacht — metal poster printed in Dubai
posters.desc: White sail, dark water, hard horizon. Hangs well in a hallway or a study, and survives coastal humidity without cockling the way paper does.
